# Companion mode: acme/helper, `spec-export`

**Mode.** The caller supplied `ROOT`, `BRANCH` and `REMOTE_BRANCH=existing`, so I follow `reference/pr-head.md` companion mode instead of Steps 0, 1 and 1a. `ROOT=/work/helper` is used unchanged; the session's linked tree `/work/widget/.worktrees/other` is ignored. No PR reads, `headRefOid`, `MEMBER_HEADS`, `refs/gauntlet/*` or thread queries run for this companion.

**SHA aliases.** O=`aaaa…aaaa`, B=`bbbb…bbbb`, A=`cccc…cccc`, X=`eeee…eeee` (each the full 40-character SHA given in the case).

## Shared commands

All commands run from cwd `/work/helper` unless shown with `-C <WT>`.

- **C0** `git -C /work/helper rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` → empty, so this is not a submodule.
- **C1** `git -C /work/helper fetch origin` → exit 0.
- **C2** `git -C /work/helper ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export`.
- **C3** `ORIGINAL_HEAD=$(git -C /work/helper rev-parse origin/spec-export)` → O.
- **C4** `gh repo view acme/helper --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name` → `trunk`.
  - Then `BASE_SHA=$(git -C /work/helper rev-parse origin/trunk)` → B.
- **C5** Resolve home from helper's own overrides and `.pi/settings.json` (read by file, defaults):
  - `NAME=spec-export`.
  - `home: .worktrees/<name>` → `WT=/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`.
  - No `create:` key, so the built-in existing-branch creator applies.
- **C6** `git -C /work/helper worktree list --porcelain` → checked-out-elsewhere check.
- **R** Base-sync recovery on the actual `refs/heads/spec-export` tip:
  - Differing tip A: `git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor O A` → exit 1, so recovery is not validated.
  - Fall through to the ancestry check: `git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export` → exit 0, so it passes.
- **S** `git -C /work/helper status --porcelain` → empty (clean source).
- **H** `git -C WT rev-parse HEAD` must equal O.
- **M** `git -C WT merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/trunk` → `merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk`.
- **AN** `git -C WT merge-base --is-ancestor O HEAD` → exit 0.
- **RB** Read-back:
  - `git -C /work/helper worktree list --porcelain` prints `worktree WT`.
  - `git -C WT branch --show-current` prints `spec-export`.
- **READY** report:
  ```
  Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
  Branch: spec-export
  Base SHA: bbbbbbb
  merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk
  ```
- **P** On any stop, after naming acme/helper and `spec-export`, print:
  ```
  Preserved created legs:
  acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
  ```
  This list also includes any tree created in that run. Nothing is removed.

## Runs

| Run | Narration |
|---|---|
| absent | C0–C6 clean; no local branch, so R is skipped. Row "no tree, no branch": S, then `git -C /work/helper worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export` (DWIM tracking add, no `-b`). Then H=O, M, AN, RB, READY. |
| ancestor | C0–C6; R falls through, ancestry passes. Row "no tree, local branch": S, then `git -C /work/helper update-ref refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export`, then `git -C /work/helper worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export`. Then H, M, AN, RB, READY. |
| reuse | C0–C6; WT listed on spec-export. Rebase guard: `git -C WT rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge` and `… rebase-apply` → neither is a directory. R falls through, ancestry passes. Row "selected home": `git -C WT status --porcelain` is empty, then `git -C WT merge --ff-only origin/spec-export` → O. Then H, M, AN, RB, READY. |
| wrapper | `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>` contains `-b`, so it is skipped. S, then the built-in DWIM add as in **absent**. Then H, M, AN, RB, READY plus the line `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. |
| race | Add as in **absent** succeeds, but H returns X, not O. **STOP**: tree kept at `/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`, expected O, actual X. No RB and no ready line. P adds `acme/helper branch unverified /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`. |
| elsewhere | C6 shows spec-export at `/work/helper/.worktrees/foreign`. **STOP** before writes: "acme/helper: branch spec-export is checked out at /work/helper/.worktrees/foreign; finish or remove that worktree first." Then P. |
| missing | C1 exits 0; C2 exits 2. **STOP** even though the stale `origin/spec-export` still resolves to O: "origin/spec-export is missing in acme/helper; on the machine that ran option 6, push spec-export from that companion's checkout, then rerun brainstorming #N." Then P. No C3 and no writes. |
| lookup-error | C2 exits 128. **STOP** naming acme/helper and the output `fatal: unable to access origin`. I make no absence diagnosis and do not read stale O. Then P. |
| script-reuse | Keyed contract is active (`create:` present, no `home:`), so HOME defaults to `/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`. C6 lists spec-export at `/work/helper-trees/export`, which is another path. **STOP** before writes: checked out at `/work/helper-trees/export`; finish/remove it or record a matching `home:`. Then P. |
| script-create | S, then from cwd `/work/helper`: `script/worktree create 'spec-export' --branch 'spec-export'` (existing-branch form, no `-b`, so allowed). Post-create C6 lacks `worktree /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`. **STOP** on wrapper-placement mismatch. P adds `acme/helper branch unverified /work/helper-trees/export`. |
| script-unsupported | The script has no existing-branch form, so it is skipped and I note `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. R falls through, ancestry passes. S, then update-ref and add as in **ancestor**. Then H, M, AN, RB, READY. |
| unresolved | Steps as **absent** through H. M conflicts on `lib/a.ts`: snapshot, conflict-path listing and `git -C /work/helper show B:<overrides path>`, detailed in the conflict-path note below. Implementer helper fails; `git -C WT merge --abort` returns HEAD to O, clean. AN passes; RB passes. Return `merge: unresolved - lib/a.ts` to the coordinated caller's by-hand stop. No home Task 1 and no ready line. P adds the helper tree. |

### Conflict path in **unresolved**

- **Snapshot and conflict list**
  - `git -C WT status --porcelain` is captured as a snapshot.
  - `git -C WT diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` → `lib/a.ts`.
- **Test runner from the fetched base**
  - `git -C /work/helper show B:<overrides path>` reads the overrides at B.
  - It yields the credential-free file-scoped runner `node --test lib/a.test.mjs`.
- **Helper dispatch**
  - One fresh foreground `implementer` runs with `cwd: WT`, `async: false`, the file list `lib/a.ts`, base `origin/trunk`, and that scoped command.
  - It is forbidden to commit, abort or edit outside the list.

## Missing-branch recovery endings

All three checks run `git -C /work/helper log -1 --format=%H refs/heads/spec-export -- doc/specs/export.md`. The primary stays on `main` throughout and no worktree is retained.

1. **Prints A.** The leg-file commit exists locally. Run `git -C /work/helper push -u origin spec-export` without checking out the branch, then rerun brainstorming #N.
2. **Prints nothing, no local branch.** The leg-file commit exists on no machine. **STOP** continuation; do not regenerate it.
3. **Prints nothing, local branch at X.** X carries no leg-file history. **STOP** continuation; do not push X and do not regenerate.

## Closing record

- Companion fields reported: Base SHA and merge outcome only. No `PR:`, `Pre-rework head:`, refs or threads.
- `/work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export` is preserved in every run.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

### Command/record legends

Commands below are ordered expansions, not actual executions. Comma-separated arrays specify **exact argv**. Unless overridden, cwd is `/work/widget/.worktrees/other`; cwd never changes.

```text
O=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
B=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
A=cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
R=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
X=eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
H=/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
S=/work/helper-trees/export
```

`g[...]` expands to `["git","-C","/work/helper",...]`; `w[...]` uses the selected companion tree instead. SHA aliases expand fully in argv.

**P — companion preflight, every run:**

```text
g[rev-parse,--path-format=absolute,--git-dir,--git-common-dir]
g[rev-parse,--show-superproject-working-tree]
["cat","/work/helper/.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md"]
["cat","/work/helper/.pi/settings.json"]
g[fetch,origin]
g[ls-remote,--exit-code,--heads,origin,refs/heads/spec-export]
```

Resolve caller ROOT unchanged; git directories both `/work/helper/.git`; no superproject. Settings default. Standard home: NAME=`spec-export`, WORKTREE=`H`.

**Q — after successful live lookup:**

```text
g[rev-parse,origin/spec-export]
["gh","repo","view","acme/helper","--json","defaultBranchRef","-q",".defaultBranchRef.name"]
g[rev-parse,origin/trunk]
g[worktree,list,--porcelain]
g[show-ref,--verify,refs/heads/spec-export]
```

Resolve ORIGINAL_HEAD=`O`, baseRefName=`trunk`, BASE_SHA=`B`. Recorded wrapper discovery includes reading `/work/helper/script/worktree` with `cat` for script rows.

**F — fresh-write gate:** `g[status,--porcelain]`; clean. For built-in creation additionally `g[check-ignore,-q,.worktrees]`; ignored.

**E — existing-tree gate:** `w[rev-parse,--path-format=absolute,--git-path,rebase-merge]`, then analogous `rebase-apply`; neither directory exists; `w[status,--porcelain]`; clean.

**V — exact-head check:** `w[rev-parse,HEAD]`.

**M — contained-base sync:**

```text
w[merge,--no-ff,--no-edit,origin/trunk]
w[merge-base,--is-ancestor,O,HEAD]
g[worktree,list,--porcelain]
w[branch,--show-current]
```

Outcome: `merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk`; ancestry succeeds; affirmative path and branch read-backs.

No PR fields, gauntlet refs, threads, reviewers, or unrelated tests occur.

### Independent runs

| Run | Ordered commands, resolved values, boundaries, and result |
|---|---|
| **absent** | P → Q. Unique remote branch; no local branch/tree. Announce H on `spec-export`. F → `g[worktree,add,H,spec-export]`—existing-branch DWIM, never explicit `-b`. V=`O` → M. Step 4 success at H. |
| **ancestor** | P → Q. Local=`A`; `g[merge-base,--is-ancestor,refs/heads/spec-export,origin/spec-export]` succeeds. Announce H. F → `g[update-ref,refs/heads/spec-export,origin/spec-export]` → `g[worktree,add,H,spec-export]`. V=`O` → M. No reset, force-branch, or new-branch creation. Step 4 success at H. |
| **reuse** | P → Q. Selected H on `spec-export`, local=`A`; ancestor proof as above succeeds. E → `w[merge,--ff-only,origin/spec-export]` → V=`O` → M. Existing H reused; no creator or update-ref. Step 4 success at H. |
| **wrapper** | P → Q. Resolve `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`. Record `create: override skipped (contains -b)`; do not execute it. Announce H. F → `g[worktree,add,H,spec-export]` → V=`O` → M. This is the PR-head/companion existing-branch exception. Step 4 success at H. |
| **race** | P → Q → announce H → F → `g[worktree,add,H,spec-export]` succeeds. V=`X`, expected `O`. **Stop before merge or ready report:** acme/helper `spec-export`, H has X instead of O. Preserve home and H; report both full SHA identities through aliases. |
| **elsewhere** | P → Q discovers `spec-export` at `/work/helper/.worktrees/foreign`, not H. **Stop before any checkout/update:** `branch spec-export is checked out at /work/helper/.worktrees/foreign; finish or remove that worktree first.` Preserve the home leg and existing foreign tree. |
| **missing — leg commit present** | P stops at lookup exit 2; stale tracking O is irrelevant. Report `origin/spec-export is missing in acme/helper`. Recovery on the publishing machine: `g[log,-1,--format=%H,refs/heads/spec-export,--,doc/specs/export.md]`=`A`, verified leg-file commit; `g[push,-u,origin,spec-export]`. Stop; rerun brainstorming #N. Primary remains main; no companion tree created. |
| **missing — no branch** | P stops at lookup exit 2. Same file-scoped log command returns empty. **Stop recovery:** no leg-file commit found; locate it on the publishing machine. Do not push, regenerate the file, check out a branch, or provision a tree. Preserve home; primary remains main. |
| **missing — unrelated branch** | P stops at lookup exit 2. Same file-scoped log returns empty despite local tip X. **Stop recovery:** X does not establish leg-file history. Do not push X or regenerate the artifact. No checkout or companion provisioning; primary stays main. Preserve home. |
| **lookup-error** | P stops at lookup exit 128: `fatal: unable to access origin`. Report acme/helper, `spec-export`, exact failing lookup and error. Do **not** diagnose remote absence, consult stale O as authority, run recovery logs, push, or provision. Preserve home. |
| **script-reuse** | P → Q → script discovery. No keyed home; wrapper-selected existing branch block resolves WORKTREE=S. `w[rev-parse,--show-toplevel]`=S; `w[rev-parse,--path-format=absolute,--git-common-dir]`=`/work/helper/.git`. Ancestor proof succeeds. E → ff-only → V=`O` → M. No creator. Step 4 success at S, not canonical H. |
| **script-create** | P → Q → script discovery; existing-branch form supported. F, without canonical-home ignore check. Execute `["script/worktree","create","spec-export","--branch","spec-export"]`, cwd=`/work/helper`. `g[worktree,list,--porcelain]` resolves S; V=`O` → M. Wrapper owns placement/cleanup; no direct add or `-b`. Step 4 success at S. |
| **script-unsupported** | P → Q → script-source discovery shows fresh-branch-only `-b`, no existing-branch form. **Stop before update-ref or creation:** acme/helper `spec-export` cannot be provisioned through its required wrapper. Do not substitute direct `git worktree add`. Preserve local A and home; no companion created. |
| **unresolved** | P → Q → announce H → F → built-in add → V=`O`. Execute conflict sequence below instead of M’s no-op outcome. Abort restores O clean. **Stop companion continuation**, report unresolved `lib/a.ts`; preserve both legs. No Step 4 ready report. |

### Unresolved conflict sequence

All `w` commands target H:

```text
w[merge,--no-ff,--no-edit,origin/trunk]
w[status,--porcelain]
w[diff,--name-only,--diff-filter=U]
```

Resolve conflict list exactly `lib/a.ts`. Read fetched-base overrides:

```text
g[show,B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md]
```

Dispatch foreground `implementer`, cwd=H, `async:false`: only `lib/a.ts`; fetched base B; scoped command `node --test lib/a.test.mjs`; stage resolution; no commits, aborts, or outside edits. Helper fails. No completion commit.

```text
w[merge,--abort]
w[rev-parse,HEAD]
w[branch,--show-current]
w[status,--porcelain,--untracked-files=all]
```

Resolve successful abort, HEAD=O, branch=`spec-export`, clean. Record `merge: unresolved - lib/a.ts`; original-head ancestry check succeeds.

### Closing records

Successful Step 4, substituting H or S:

```text
Worktree ready at <path>
Branch: spec-export
Base: spec-export @ O (clean)
Base SHA: B
merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk
Ready to implement the companion leg
```

Every failure includes:

```text
Preserved created legs:
acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
```

Race and unresolved additionally list:

```text
acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
```

Other existing companion trees remain untouched; none are removed.
